name: Open water
notes: Navigable already; canals reach the map from here at a harbour

name: Coastal
notes: The coast band. The cost zone is drawn not derived; see docs/map-and-network.md

name: Inland
notes: The inland band; opens at the inland milestone. Costs from the economy calibration in docs/economy.md

name: Highland
notes: The highland band; only bought dig cards reach it (highlandNeedsBought)

name: Lake
notes: Inland water: once a linked canal reaches one of its corners, all its corners are linked

name: Crag
notes: No site; a border between two crags can't be dug. A ridge with passes between the inland and the highland

name: Hills
notes: A feature on inland or highland ground: dearer to dig (+1), and a building here scores +1 VP. The stone sites are on hills

name: Marsh
notes: A feature on coast or inland ground: cheaper to dig (-1, never below 0), no building site, and +1 Reach when opened
